title: app-showcase: the expense sign-off approval (会签) ends without writing its outcome back — EXP-2001 still reads "Submitted" after both groups approved
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi7SkqaNxU2Ef8P2DMmp2hPJ)_

Found during an exploratory walkthrough of the showcase.

## Environment

- objectstack `main` @ `b9c7a8f`, `PORT=3000 pnpm dev` (showcase, fresh DB), objectui `main` @ `6fb31dc`

## Steps

1. As the dev admin, open the pending approval **费用报告签批 · EXP-2001** from the home page's 待审批 card, choose **通过**, add a comment, confirm. The request shows 会签进度 1 / 2 (manager 1/1, finance 0/1).
2. Sign in as `auditor.demo@example.com`, open the same request from the notification, approve.

## Actual

- The approval request moves to **已批准** and its timeline lists both approvals, which is right.
- The expense report itself is unchanged: the request page still shows the record's `Status: Submitted`, and
  `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_expense_report` returns `EXP-2001 → status: "submitted"`.

## Why

`showcase_expense_signoff` (`src/automation/flows/index.ts`) is `start → dual_signoff (approval) → approved | rejected`, and both outcomes are bare `end` nodes. Nothing on either branch updates the record, so the business object never learns the decision. The node also sets `lockRecord: true`; I did not check whether the lock is released after the decision.

## Expected

A reader of the showcase sees the approval's result on the record it governed, for example an `update_record` on each branch setting `status` to `approved` / `rejected`. As it stands the marquee 会签 demo ends with a "Submitted" expense report that has, in fact, been approved, which reads as a platform defect to anyone trying the demo. The other approval demos that end on bare `end` nodes (the committee quorum flow sits right below this one) may want the same treatment.
